audience.primary: TikTok Shop sellers on Indonesian platform who need API-first product research automation
segments: Solo sellers with 10-100 SKUs doing manual competitor research
Small agencies managing 5-20 TikTok Shop accounts
Dropshippers monitoring trending products across regions
audience.size_estimate: High-volume Indonesian TikTok Shop sellers (100K+ active sellers)

positioning.headline: API-first competitor intelligence for TikTok Shop sellers
positioning.value_proposition: Automate product research, pricing intelligence, and trend detection via API instead of manual browsing
differentiators: API-first (not a dashboard SaaS) — integrates into existing workflows
Puppeteer-based scraping bypasses basic anti-bot measures
USDC micropayments via x402 — no subscription required for low volume
Polar.sh subscription available for high-volume users at $29/mo

channel.primary: Direct outreach via TikTok Shop seller communities (Discord, Telegram, Instagram)
channel.secondary: Content marketing (TikTok/Instagram short-form demos showing API in action)
channel.tertiary: Hacker News / Product Hunt launch for developer audience
launch_sequence: 1. Prepare demo video showing API response for Indonesian TikTok Shop search
2. Post in relevant seller communities with value-first message
3. Offer free tier (5 queries/day) with Polar upgrade path
4. Collect feedback and iterate on messaging

opt_out_compliance.opt_out_mechanism: Reply UNSUBSCRIBE or click opt-out link in every outreach message
opt_out_compliance.gdpr_notes: Store opt-out requests in opt-out log; never re-contact opted-out addresses
opt_out_compliance.data_retention: 30 days for outreach log; permanent for opt-out list

sales_handoff.trigger: Free tier user hits 5-query limit within 3 days OR replies to outreach
sales_handoff.process: Growth marketer tags lead → Sales sends personalized Polar checkout link → Fulfillment onboards after payment
sales_handoff.next_bottleneck: Polar checkout integration required before handoff can execute
sales_handoff.failure_signal: No Polar checkout URL generated within 24 hours of handoff trigger
